notes_for_editor: Two searches returned only other Otero County towers (Bluewater, Weed, Monjeau and similar), which are not used. No NGS datasheet for Silver was found; the station ID would need a lookup. The Forest Lookouts Silver page has no body text beyond its header, so it gives only the agency label. The NM list gives the status, county and coordinates only. The story stays short because no dated or narrative source was reachable.
